Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> is tormented with guilt over the quest failure.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、自分を責めて苦しんでいる。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>感到相当自责且痛苦。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>感到相當自責且痛苦。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> est tourmentée par la culpabilité de l'échec de la quête.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Über den fehlgeschlagenen Auftrag ist <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> von Schuldgefühlen geplagt.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Por el fracaso de la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se atormenta con culpa.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> falha na missão e se culpa, sofrendo.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> รู้สึกผิดและทรมานใจกับการทำภารกิจล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> yang gagal dalam misi, tersiksa oleh rasa bersalah.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dằn vặt trong tội lỗi vì nhiệm vụ thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: क्वेस्ट में विफल होने के कारण, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ग्लानि से पीड़ित है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: D-don't worry. You'll do better next time.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: い、いや。次うまくやれば大丈夫だよ！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 没、没关系。下次做好就行了！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 沒、沒關係。下次做好就行了！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Ne t'inquiète pas. Tu feras mieux la prochaine fois !
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: M-mach dir keine Sorgen. Nächstes Mal schaffst du es bestimmt!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: N-no te preocupes. ¡La próxima vez lo harás mejor!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: N-não se preocupe. Você vai se sair melhor da próxima vez!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: อ๊ะ ไม่เป็นไรหรอกครับ! ครั้งหน้าทำให้ดีก็พอแล้ว!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: T-tidak apa-apa. Kamu akan lebih baik lain kali!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đ-đừng lo. Lần tới cậu sẽ làm tốt hơn thôi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: न-नहीं, चिंता मत करो। अगली बार तुम और बेहतर करोगे।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Here, drink this and feel better.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: ほら、これ飲んで元気出して。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tiens. Bois ça et reprends des forces.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Hier, trink das und fühl dich besser.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Aqui, beba isto e se sinta melhor.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: เอาล่ะ ดื่มนี่ซะ แล้วรู้สึกดีขึ้นนะ.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Ini. Minumlah ini dan semangat lagi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đây, uống cái này đi cho khỏe.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: यह लो, इसे पीओ और बेहतर महसूस करो।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 자신을 믿어주는만큼 다음에는 꼭 잘해보겠다고 한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vowed to repay my belief in her next time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、自分を信じてくれた分だけ、次は上手くやってみせると誓った。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说既然你这么相信我，下次一定会努力做好。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說既然你這麼相信我，下次一定會努力做好。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> promet de faire mieux la prochaine fois, pour ne pas me décevoir.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> prometió que la próxima vez lo haría bien para recompensar mi confianza en ella.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> prometeu que, na próxima vez, fará o seu melhor para não decepcionar a confiança que deposita em mim.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สาบานว่าจะตอบแทนความเชื่อใจของผมในครั้งหน้าให้ได้ครับ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bersumpah akan membalas kepercayaanku padanya lain kali.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hứa sẽ làm tốt hơn vào lần sau để đáp lại niềm tin mà người khác dành cho mình.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने वादा किया कि वह अगली बार आपके विश्वास पर खरा उतरेगी।

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 相変わらず、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の声には自信がなさそうだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的声音听起来依然没有自信。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的聲音聽起來依然沒有自信。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: La voix de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> manquait encore de confiance.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A voz de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia sem confiança.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: เสียงของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ยังคงสั่นเครืออยู่ครับ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Giọng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn còn thiếu tự tin.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> की आवाज़ अभी भी डगमगा रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quickly bounced back to her usual self after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はポーションを受け取ると、元気を取り戻した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retrouvé ses forces après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> erholte sich schnell, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> recuperó rápidamente su ánimo habitual tras recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> rapidamente voltou ao normal depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> กลับมาเป็นปกติอย่างรวดเร็วหลังจากได้รับยาครับ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dengan cepat kembali ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã lấy lại tinh thần sau khi nhận được thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> फौरन अपने पूर्व रूप में वापस आ गई।
